content: AI tools spend by month: Jul 4.4k Aug 4.8k Sep 5.2k. extrapolate to Dec and write one line for Sam
At ~8%/month, AI tools reach ~$6.5k/month by December (~$70k annualised).
For October so far: revenue and FIFO COGS from the portal + layers. remind me what accruals I need for a mid-month view

For a mid-month view: (1) payroll — only the first pay run has posted, accrue the second half; (2) unpaid bills; (3) approved-but-unpaid member payouts (incl. ACH on hold) → 2100; (4) wallet balances → 2150; (5) consider an inventory write-down where market < FIFO cost.
